changes.U1: POST uploads returns HTTP 202 with state waiting, limit and freesAt only for busy count slots. Studio preserves FIFO, the same create body, 30-second re-asks and its existing words. Byte, retained-byte, disk and attempt refusals are unchanged.
changes.U2: Status and derived lookup read the case without locking it. Create, part, finish claim, abort, cleanup and storage-job metadata use KEY SHARE before upload/job locks. Only source publication takes case UPDATE. All three quota acquisitions follow the case fence; part/finish also take upload first. Storage and original hashing stay outside quota transactions.
changes.U3: The existing native conversion job keeps its renewed attempt while sleeping, without a transaction or byte buffer. Committed retain/cleanup wakes it locally; freesAt or a 30-second timer covers other processes. The admission window ends 30 minutes after the first busy slot. Waiting preserves layer/count/CRS words; successful admission retains and enrols each child once. Timeout keeps converted bytes and does not ask for re-enrolment. Other refusals retain their words.

lockReview.order: Receipt metadata: case KEY SHARE -> upload UPDATE -> optional quota -> part/job/outbox. Publication: case UPDATE -> upload -> source/job -> outbox. Status: plain case read -> upload UPDATE, with no later case lock.
lockReview.compatibility: Cut remains case UPDATE -> item -> job. Mapping publication and package commit are unchanged. Receipt paths never upgrade KEY SHARE; publication uses a separate transaction. No path holding quota waits for a case or an existing upload lock.
lockReview.createReplay: Concurrent same-key creates recheck under quota. Replay reads a locked upload/parts snapshot only after quota is released, avoiding upload/quota inversion; a different digest still conflicts.
